data.long_meaning: The name Dane is derived from the Old English word 'dæn,' which means 'valiant' or 'strong.' It was originally used as a nickname for someone who displayed these qualities. The name Dane carries the meaning “Valiant, Strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dane usually hope their child will grow to embody valiant, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
